# Case 39: Gap argued with the paper's own design choice
Skill: write-related-work
Expected gates: G-SH-gap
Language: en
Snippet:
> However, none of the existing charging studies adopts incremental state synchronization or a feasible-interval action mapping. These studies therefore cannot preserve service continuity.
Why it fails: incremental synchronization and the action mapping are this paper's own mechanisms. The gap should state what the cited studies assume (the charging robot stays in service until a replacement arrives) and what that assumption costs in the target setting.
